title: 第8章 会议，药贩子团伙（儿童节快乐）
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

西城警署四楼大会议室。

许景川进去的时候里面已经坐了好些个人，本来正在聊天，但随着他入内，都停了下来齐刷刷看过去。

“哟，许队长来了，刚刚还正聊起你呢，来来来，坐这边。”周川笑着起身招呼，指了指身旁的空位。

许景川快步上前，“周组。”

“给大家介绍一下，这就是我们刑事组三队新任队长许景川。”周川热情熟络的拍着他的肩膀大声说道。

其话音刚落，一个身材魁梧的短发猛男就站了起来，对许景川伸出一只手，“特警中队中队长，武元魁。”

“武中队好，初来乍到，还望多多关照。”许景川微微弓腰握住。

特警中队下面不仅有负责攻坚反恐的特战队，还有负责群体性事件的防爆队，是警察系统里最硬的部门。

武元魁笑容和煦而灿烂，眼中满是蠢蠢欲动，“听周组长说许队长独自对付三名持枪匪徒不落下风还能手刃两贼，且毫发无伤，这身手着实让我技痒，改天我们切磋切磋？”

“许队长，我们武中队可是出了名的武痴，好久没遇到过对手了。

你要是能打败他的话，这青川警局第一高手的宝座就归你了。”一个叼着烟的秃顶中年男子乐呵呵道。

见许景川看向自己，他抖了抖烟灰说道：“巡警组副组长，刘耀文。”

“刘副组说笑了，我那点三脚猫功夫哪是武中队的对手，顶多给他当陪练。”许景川摇着头连连摆手。

“行了，别谦虚，我看老武就不见得是你对手，别因为他是长官就手下留情，狠狠揍，当初内部比武时这家伙在擂台上揍我可没手软啊。”

周川怨念十足的咬牙说道。

武元魁哈哈一笑，爽朗又中气十足的说道：“许队长听见了吧？你家组长可指望你帮他报仇呢，就这么定了哈，改天约。”

“那就感谢武中队指点了。”对方是长官，许景川只能应了下来。

周川大笑着揽住了许景川的肩膀说道：“到时候我去给你加油助威。”

随后又一一为他介绍在座的人。

刑事组另外四个队长以及副组长，还有交通组、巡警组、特警中队的组长和队长等等……

基本上警署的中高层都到了。

这更让许景川好奇会议的内容。

“哒~哒~哒~”

随着高跟鞋与地面碰撞发出的清脆声渐行渐近，会议室里的交谈声逐渐消失，所有人正襟危坐。

署长伊芙琳走了进来。

身后是抱着档案袋的秘书。

“唰！”

“长官好！”

霎时间众人齐刷刷起身敬礼。

伊芙琳面容冷峻，一言不发，迈着修长的双腿向主位走去，黑色警服下圆滚滚的胸脯有韵律的轻颤。

让人情不自禁对其另眼相看。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Large conference room on the fourth floor of Xicheng Police Station.

When Xu Jingchuan entered, there were already many people sitting inside. They were chatting, but as he entered, they all stopped and looked over.

"Hey, Captain Xu is here. I was talking about you just now. Come on, come on, sit here." Zhou Chuan stood up with a smile and greeted him, pointing to the empty seat next to him.

Xu Jingchuan stepped forward quickly and said, "Group Zhou."

"Let me introduce to you, this is Xu Jingchuan, the new captain of our third criminal team." Zhou Chuan patted his shoulder enthusiastically and said loudly.

As soon as he finished speaking, a burly man with short hair stood up and stretched out a hand to Xu Jingchuan, "Lieutenant of the Special Police Squadron, Wu Yuankui."

"Hello, Captain Wu, I'm new here, so I hope you'll take care of me." Xu Jingchuan bowed his waist slightly and held it.

The SWAT squadron not only has a special force responsible for combating anti-terrorism, but also an explosion-proof team responsible for mass incidents. It is the hardest department in the police system.

Wu Yuankui's smile was warm and bright, and his eyes were full of eagerness to move, "I heard from Team Leader Zhou that Captain Xu could deal with three gun-wielding gangsters alone and still managed to kill them both without getting hurt. This skill really makes me excited. Let's compete some other time?"

"Captain Xu, our Wushu Squadron is famous for its martial arts fanatics, and we haven't encountered an opponent in a long time.

If you can defeat him, the throne of the top master of the Qingchuan Police Department will belong to you."A bald middle-aged man with a cigarette in his mouth said cheerfully.

Seeing Xu Jingchuan looking at him, he shook out the ashes and said, "Deputy leader of the patrol team, Liu Yaowen."

"Deputy Team Liu is joking. My three-legged cat kung fu is no match for the Wushu Squadron. I can only serve as his sparring partner." Xu Jingchuan shook his head and waved his hands repeatedly.

"Okay, don't be modest. I don't think Lao Wu is your opponent. Don't be merciful just because he is a commander. Beat him up. This guy didn't show mercy when he beat me in the ring during the internal competition."

Zhou Chuan gritted his teeth and said with resentment.

Wu Yuankui laughed and said cheerfully and confidently: "Captain Xu, did you hear that? Your team leader is counting on you to help him get revenge. It's settled like this. We'll make another date."

"Then thank you, Squadron Wu, for your guidance." The other party was a commander, so Xu Jingchuan could only agree.

Zhou Chuan laughed, put his arm around Xu Jingchuan's shoulders and said, "I will go and cheer you up then."

Then he introduced everyone present to him one by one.

The other four captains and deputy leaders of the criminal team, as well as the leaders and captains of the traffic team, patrol team, special police squadron, etc...

Basically all the middle and senior management of the police department arrived.

This made Xu Jingchuan even more curious about the content of the meeting.

"Da~da~da~"

As the crisp sound of high-heeled shoes colliding with the ground gradually approached, the conversation in the conference room gradually disappeared, and everyone sat upright.

Director Evelin walked in.

Behind him is the secretary holding a portfolio.

"Uh-huh!"

"Hello, sir!"

In an instant, everyone stood up and saluted.

Evelin had a stern face and said nothing, walking towards the main seat with her slender legs, her round breasts trembling rhythmically under her black police uniform.

People can't help but look at him in a new light.
